note: A throwaway keypair from 'adb keygen', shared by every implementation that has to agree about ADB keys. The fingerprint was computed independently with openssl (SPKI DER -> sha256 -> base64, unpadded) so that neither the TypeScript parser nor the Rust one in adb-bridge can define it into being correct. adbkey.testonly.pem is the matching private key: it exists so Rust tests can produce real signatures, it has never been enrolled anywhere, and it authorizes nothing.
